assertion_analysis.fails_if: No loaded alias is instrumented; the binding instrument refuses an unobserved target.
The synthetic live-record reader does not see all forty written pointers.
The lazy recovery export and production review-dispatch implementation no longer bind the same target.
The normal terminal-duty path does not reach the review instrument forty times; the zero-call fallback claim loses its positive control.
The deliberately old station record is incorrectly treated as a fresh liveness verdict.
The live working-pointer follower stops or settles before sixty one-second sleeps.
Restoring the original per-sample _population_has_live_work call exceeds two population calculations; recorded base counter is sixty.
The measured follower never reaches the instrumented population implementation, preventing a vacuous upper-bound pass.
Restoring terminal-duty traversal calls the instrumented review-in-flight mechanism.
A working population emits an unwarranted terminal event.
The original per-sample path or an overlong cache replaces observations at zero and sixty seconds, or a terminal pointer is still counted live.
Terminal detection enters the full review-duty walk.
Drained work never settles or emits the wrong event kind.
Removing the stale grace extension settles sixty seconds early; extending the cache/grace too far also misses the independently fixed 120+grace deadline.
A fresh empty station answer fails to settle the previously live population.
Serving the cached live fallback instead of the fresh station answer delays settlement beyond the next sample.
Station recovery triggers any review-in-flight walk.
Observed-peer live work fails to keep the follower sampling for sixty seconds.
Separate stale recalculations per observed population break the shared interval cache.
A follower ignores the observed peer and settles despite its working pointer.
Restoring the phase-only fallback makes any of the three own-record delivery/review variants settle before 181 samples; recorded phase-only control fails each case.
The same phase-only regression emits a settle event while the delivery or review is pending.
Pending work bypasses the population instrument or recomputes more than four times in 181 seconds.
Pending-record handling restores the review-in-flight walk.
Promotion removal does not lead to one settle event, or restoring phase-only behavior prevents the initial saw-live latch; recorded control observes no settle event.
Promotion removal is not read at the next sixty-second boundary and followed by sixty seconds of stale grace.
Promotion handling walks the review-in-flight mechanism.

assertion_independence: No assertion compares an echoed supplied value with itself: timings and counts are independently fixed expectations on follower behavior; event-kind constants name output protocol, and grace is combined with a fixed independent interval. Fixture and instrument assertions establish preconditions, not regression coverage.
